issue_body:
# Performance below threshold — project detail pages (persistent, 3+ cycles)

Audited: **2026-10-02T14:44:38.520Z**

## Affected pages

| Page | Perf | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 82 (was 81) | 4259 ms | 137 ms |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 79 (was 78) | 4450 ms | 143 ms |

> The home page (`/`) recovered to 85 this cycle and is no longer a concern.

## Why this matters
Both project detail pages have been below the 85 performance threshold for **at least 3 consecutive audit cycles** with no material LCP improvement. LCP remains the dominant bottleneck (~4.3–4.5 s); TBT is acceptable. This is a persistent structural issue, not jitter.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert hero/LCP images to WebP or AVIF** with correct `srcset` / `sizes` to reduce initial payload on both project pages.
2. **Add `fetchpriority="high"`** to the LCP image element so the browser prioritises it earlier in the load waterfall.
3. **Preconnect or preload** critical third-party origins (fonts, CDN assets) that may be adding latency before LCP.
4. **Code-split** any non-critical JS bundles on project pages to reduce time-to-interactive and indirectly help LCP.

## Visual status
All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile — no layout breakage, overflow, missing sections, or contrast issues detected.
